name: manual_e01e7e
claim: When a force-push replaces the HEAD of an open PR branch with a commit that is already merged into the PR target branch, GitHub automatically closes the PR as merged. This is a reliable way to detect that the force-push landed the intended ancestor work into the base.

decisions.notes: Final Remedy 2026-07-14: After force-pushing PR #211 branch to 32f0b76 (which was already merged into corrected main via merge commit), GitHub detected the PR as MERGED. Confirmed both PR #211 and #212 showed MERGED status after their commits were pushed into main.
